outcome: Length of stay in health facility after birth
cohort: The study included 4,567 women in Cameroon who had a live birth in a health facility between 2013 and 2018.
finding: More than one in four women (28.8%) who gave birth in facilities in Cameroon were discharged too early, with early discharge significantly predicted by maternal age < 20 years, unemployment, non-Christian religions, and region of residence.
mod_finding: The proportion of women discharged too early was higher after vaginal birth (29.7%) compared to caesarean section (15.1%).
